comment: The player types cheats into the message line (ProcessCheatText 0x40dee0 reseeds the CRT generator, SendCheatCommand 0x473d40 sends the new word as command 0x12, ExecCheat 0x472530 and ApplyCheatFlags 0x40d9d0 run it): show me the money, something for nothing (every upgrade one level up, the Vulture's Ion Thrusters speed), black sheep wall on and off again (the one-shot tile rewrite 0x46c070), operation cwal while the Barracks trains a Marine, whats mine is mine, breathe deep, and a line that is no cheat (only the reseed).
